messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary in eu-west-1 for model alias 'gpt-redwood-v2-2026-canary' is showing a sharp spike in token-decoding errors and increased perplexity.  error-rate=7.8% (baseline 0.2%). Auto-pager sent to #incidents and oncall.

sarah: seeing the same in dashboards, a couple of customers reported garbled completions. Any rollout activity rn?

mike: I just promoted a weightset during the rollout window, pinging deploy pipeline: artifact tag weights-prod-2026 -> promoted to canary. I didn't touch tokenizer.

alice: oncall here, pulling logs. Can you drop the exact artifact tag and the deployment id?

mike: deploy-id: deploy/rls-2026-0521-ccf9  artifact: weights-prod-2026 (sha: f2a9b7c)  I can revert if we need immediate mitigation.

ops-bot: Runbook step triggered: "Canary failsafe -> disable traffic to canary". Suggested action: flip feature flag model-routing.canary to off or rollback canary alias.

alice: flipping flag now. Console: PATCH /flags/model-routing.canary {"enabled": false}  --response: 200 OK

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: model-routing.canary set to false; traffic routed back to stable in eu-west-1. Error-rate falling to 0.5% in last 30s.

nina: any indication why weights alone caused decoding errors? Could be tokenizer mapping mismatch on the promoted variant.

mike: digging into the release metadata. The weightset had metadata.tokenizer: tokenizer-v2 but the alias chain in the routing table still pointed to tokenizer-v1, so model executed with mismatched tokenizer vocabulary. Bad promotion step omitted tokenizer remap.

sarah: that explains garbled tokens. Customer impact: CS says 3 customers in EU had truncated completions and one retry spiked error budgets. Not widespread but noticeable.

alice: mitigation checklist: 1) kill traffic to canary (done) 2) rollback weight alias to pre-canary 3) confirm tokenizer mapping consistent 4) contact affected customers via CS 5) create postmortem. I'll take 1-3 now.

mike: rolling alias back: CLI: redwood alias promote --alias gpt-redwood-v2-canary --to pre-canary-2026 --force  --status: queued

ops-bot: Note: queued rollout/alias operation may take ~45s to converge across edge. Watch metrics and sampling traces.

alice: alias rollback completed. Verified logs: tokenizer mapping now consistent (tokenizer-v1) and token error-rate back to baseline 0.17% across eu-west-1.

jason: taking over handoff for next shift. Action items for follow-up: - Postmortem owner: mike - Add gating to ensure tokenizer metadata must be validated when promoting weightsets - Add a canary validation step that runs sample prompts and looks for token-level drift - Customer outreach: CS to notify affected accounts with apology and mitigation notes

sarah: noted. Mike, please include exact commands and timeline in the postmortem so SRE can add automated checks.

mike: will do, gathering timestamps and diff of metadata. Preliminary root cause: manual promotion step omitted tokenizer remap check; our CI allowed weightset metadata mismatch to be promoted.

alice: estimate time to close immediate remediation tasks: rollback done, traffic stable. We'll keep this thread open for postmortem link + follow-ups.

incident-bot: :page_with_curl: Incident tagged: sev2. Pager resolved: oncall acknowledged and mitigation executed. Please add postmortem link when ready.

jason: I'll schedule a 30-min blameless incident review tomorrow. Adding Nina from runtime and CS lead to the invite.

mike: posting rough timeline in case it helps: 5188883220 deploy promoted weights-prod-2026 to canary; 5188883275 first anomalies in logs; 5188883301 incident-bot alert; 5188883325 flag flipped to disable canary; 5188883389 alias rollback completed; 5188883500 metrics stabilized.

sarah: thanks team. Small customer impact but good quick mitigation. :thumbsup:

jason: handoff complete, putting this in follow-up board: [PM-1178] Canary promotion validation and [SRE-402] Enforce tokenizer/weight metadata checks.

alice: closing active pager. If anyone finds residual errors post-rotation, post here or ping oncall.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Pager closed by alice at 5188883640.
